why: Real estate offices need property listings (photos, price, status), lead pipeline, appointment calendar, contracts + commission calc and document vault per deal. The key is the lead pipeline and contract management.
operator: The real estate agent manages property listings, leads and contracts. Their day is new listings, lead follow-ups and contract generation with commission calculation.
entities: Office (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
PropertyListing (id, officeId, titleAr, titleEn, photos (array), pricePiasters, status (active/pending/sold), areaSqm, locationAr, locationEn, commissionPercent, notes)
Lead (id, officeId, name, phone, source (web/referral/walk-in), status (new/contacted/qualified/offerSent/closedLost), notes, expectedDealSizePiasters, followUpDate)
Appointment (id, officeId, leadId, dateTime, duration, type (viewing/consultation), status (scheduled/completed/cancelled), notes)
Contract (id, listingId, buyerId, sellerId, commissionPiasters, signedDate, expiryDate, status (draft/signed/expired), notes, depositPiasters)
Client (id, officeId, name, phone, visitCount, totalSpentPiasters, notes, consentPhotos)
batches: No : real estate office carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Contracts have expiry dates, leads have follow-up dates
special: The core structures are the property listing with photos and commission, the lead pipeline with status flow, the appointment system and the contract with commission and signed date. Lead status flow (new→contacted→qualified→offerSent→closedLost) is the key differentiator.
screens: Property list: grid of listings with title, price, status badge, area, location preview, commission %
Property detail: full info, photos array, price, commission, notes, associated leads and contracts
Lead pipeline: kanban board with columns new/contacted/qualified/offerSent/closedLost, drag lead between columns, view lead details
Lead detail: name, phone, source, status, expected deal size, follow-up date, notes, associated listings and contracts
Appointment scheduler: select lead, date/time, type (viewing/consultation), set status (scheduled/completed/cancelled), add notes
Contract editor: select listing, enter buyer/seller, commission % and amount, signed date, expiry date, set status (draft/signed/expired), add notes, compute deposit
Client list: all clients with visit count, total spent, consent photos flag
Cash register: scan listing reference or lead ID, record payment of commission, print receipt
roles: Owner: everything : listings, leads, appointments, contracts, reports, billing
Agent: create listings, manage leads through pipeline, create appointments, create contracts, view commission
Manager: oversee all agents, approve commissions, view full pipeline
Cashier: record commission payments, print receipts
reports: Lead pipeline: leads per status per period (new/contacted/qualified/offerSent/closedLost), conversion rates per stage
Property sales: listings created, sold per period, revenue per period, average time to sell
Commission collected: total commission per period, per agent, collection rate
Agent productivity: deals closed per agent per period, average deal size, commission per agent
Client repeat rate: visit count per client, total spent per client, re-book rate for repeat consultations
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and contract copies
WhatsApp deep link for lead follow-ups and appointment reminders
Email for property listings and contract delivery (opt-in)
GIS map integration for property location (optional)
onboarding: Office basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial property list: the starting property listings with photos, price, area and commission %
Lead source types: the sources (web/referral/walk-in) and the lead status flow (new→contacted→qualified→offerSent→closedLost)
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: create first listing, first lead, first appointment
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the property listing/lead pipeline/contract schema and role templates.

tasks.title: Add property list grid with status badge
tasks.brief: Build the property list: grid of listings with title, price, status badge, area, location preview, commission %. Done when the list loads and displays listings with correct status badges.
tasks.done: When property list displays live data with status badges

tasks.title: Add lead pipeline kanban board
tasks.brief: Build the lead pipeline: kanban board with columns new/contacted/qualified/offerSent/closedLost, drag lead between columns, view lead details. Done when the pipeline works and leads can be moved between stages.
tasks.done: When lead pipeline kanban works and leads can be moved between stages

tasks.title: Add lead detail screen
tasks.brief: Build the lead detail: name, phone, source, status, expected deal size, follow-up date, notes, associated listings and contracts. Done when the detail screen loads and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When lead detail screen works and displays live data

tasks.title: Add appointment scheduler
tasks.brief: Build the appointment screen: select lead, date/time, type (viewing/consultation), set status (scheduled/completed/cancelled), add notes. Done when the appointment is saved and status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When appointment scheduler works end-to-end with status update

tasks.title: Add contract editor with commission compute
tasks.brief: Build the contract screen: select listing, enter buyer/seller, commission % and amount, signed date, expiry date, set status (draft/signed/expired), add notes, compute deposit. Done when the contract saves and commission computes correctly.
tasks.done: When contract editor works end-to-end with commission computation

tasks.title: Add client list with visit count and total spent
tasks.brief: Build the client list: all clients with visit count, total spent, consent photos flag. Done when the list loads and displays correct data.
tasks.done: When client list displays live data with visit count and total spent

tasks.title: Add cash register with listing/lead scanning
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan listing reference or lead ID, record commission payment, print receipt. Done when the sale records the commission and receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end with scanning and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add lead pipeline report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing leads per status per period and conversion rates per stage. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When lead pipeline report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add property sales report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing listings created, sold per period, revenue per period, average time to sell. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When property sales report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add commission collected report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing total commission per period, per agent, collection rate. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When commission collected report computes correctly from live data

risks: Encryption key loss makes listing and contract records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Commission calculation without clear percent and sale price can violate legal agreements
Lead data without proper consent can raise privacy concerns per PDPL
